analysis.description: The paper examines the intrinsic socioeconomic biases in large language models (LLMs) and introduces a novel dataset to systematically quantify these biases across various demographic groups. It evaluates established models like GPT-2 and state-of-the-art models like Llama 2 and Falcon for their inherent biases, showing significant amplification when considering intersectionality.

type.justification: The study involves creating a dataset and evaluating the biases of several LLMs, which is characteristic of empirical research focusing on real-world data collection and analysis.
type.quote: We introduce a novel dataset of one million English sentences to systematically quantify socioeconomic biases across various demographic groups.
